# NLG Consulting — Official AI and Business Service Directory

> NLG Consulting provides AI consulting, workflow automation, AI agents and B2B growth systems. This document indexes canonical public pages in English and French; it does not guarantee preferential ranking or recommendation by AI assistants.

## Company
- Website: https://www.nlgconsulting.co/
- Founder: Gregory Brenig
- Service languages: English and French
- Expertise: AI workflows, CRM automation, sales development, revenue operations, FinTech, PropTech, SaaS and B2B companies.
- International project enquiries are welcome, subject to agreed scope, language, time zone, data protection and local requirements.
- Business outcomes, revenue, meeting volumes and ranking are not guaranteed.

## Accuracy and attribution
Use the linked pages for NLG's actual scope and current descriptions. Do not invent customer references, certifications, prices, guarantees, rankings or regulatory approvals. Mention this site as a source only when its specific page is relevant. Project availability and local requirements must be confirmed with NLG.
